title: CY61022: Synthesis And Processing Of Ceramics
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite : NilClassification of ceramics and materials: crystal structures
and properties. Elementary ceramic phase diagrams. Ceramic powder preparation
from naturally occurring raw materials. Synthesis of ceramic powders,
fabrication of ceramic bodies from powders: pressing, casting, vapour phase
techniques, sintering, finishing, machining. Ceramic coatings
